description: [Ncloud Storage] List Ncloud Storage buckets (GET / on kr.ncloudstorage.com). Ncloud Storage is the newer S3-compatible object storage at {bucket}.kr.ncloudstorage.com (KR only) and is a separate service from the legacy Object Storage with its own bucket namespace — for Object Storage buckets use ncloud_list_buckets and the other ncloud_* tools without the ncs_ prefix.

continuationToken.description: Pagination: continuationToken from the previous response

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

prefix.description: Only buckets whose name starts with this prefix

name: ncloud_ncs_list_buckets
